author: Dean Walker
text: Tom and Safari Septic were excellent to work with. Tom was knowledgeable, professional, and straightforward throughout the entire process. The work was done right, the pricing was reasonable, and I appreciated the honest service. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.

author: Julie Dimaiwat
text: I highly recommend Tom and Safari Septic. Excellent work, completely professional, fair pricing, honest.

author: Lamar Courtney
text: I know I can trust Tom to give me the best price, do the best work, and tell me the truth. Don’t hesitate to work with Safari.

author: JK W
text: I am very happy that I chose Safari Septic to fix the issues with my septic tank. Tom’s communication was excellent, and his price for the work was very fair. Tom is honest and reliable. I will use his company for any future work, and I highly recommend Safari Septic.

author: Johnny Guerriero
text: Tom completely rebuilt my drain field in just a couple days and months later I am having zero issues. He was also able to install some components that allowed me to better care for my septic system which I am super grateful for. He does great work and I will continue to go to him for all of my septic needs!
